Screener endpoint with presets, composable filters, and sorts. Inherits all query params from the legacy /api/data/scan endpoint. `mode` tells where the rows come from: `precomputed` (daily preset snapshot, used while it is less than 6 hours old), `live` (preset computed on request; can take 20-30s), or `filter` (any min_/max_ param; reads the daily indicator cache). In `precomputed` and `filter` modes, price and change fields are from the last completed daily bar: check `dataAgeSeconds`. Without `sector` or `symbols`, filter mode reads at most 1000 cache rows, so some tradeable symbols can be missing. Row keys mix camelCase (`bbPosition`, `volumeRatio`) and snake_case (`change_5d`, `max_1d_drop`). With no preset, indicator, or filter param, the response is a help object.
